notes: Direction d is the sign of the triggering move; returns are reported as reversion, -d * log return.
Volatility is the trailing 24h RMS of 1-minute log returns, excluding the current minute.
The trigger threshold is calibrated on 2021-2022 only and frozen for 2023-01 to 2026-05.
Real-time open interest uses the latest 5-minute snapshot at or before the trigger time minus the configured lag.
The ex-post open-interest label spans the episode and is not a tradable feature.
Prices after May 2026 are not loaded, so late-May paths are truncated rather than using holdout data.
